angle: What changed in Dimorphos's orbit after DART

items.claim: Before impact, Dimorphos orbited Didymos in 11 hours and 55 minutes.
items.synthesisExcerpt: Before impact, Dimorphos took 11 hours and 55 minutes to orbit the larger asteroid Didymos.
items.sourceEvidence: Provided source paraphrase: “Before impact, Dimorphos took 11 hours and 55 minutes to orbit the larger asteroid Didymos.”

items.claim: Immediately after impact, the orbital period was 32 minutes and 42 seconds shorter.
items.synthesisExcerpt: Immediately after impact, the period shortened by 32 minutes and 42 seconds, to 11 hours, 22 minutes and 37 seconds.
items.sourceEvidence: Provided source paraphrase: “Immediately after impact, the period shortened by 32 minutes and 42 seconds, to 11 hours, 22 minutes and 37 seconds.”
items.qualification: This is the immediate post-impact period, not the later settled period.

items.claim: Over subsequent weeks, the period continued to shorten as Dimorphos lost more rocky material to space.
items.synthesisExcerpt: Over subsequent weeks Dimorphos lost more rocky material to space while its orbital period continued to shorten.
items.sourceEvidence: Provided source paraphrase: “Over subsequent weeks Dimorphos lost more rocky material to space while its orbital period continued to shorten.”
items.usefulness: Distinguishes the later trend from the immediate change.
items.qualification: The evidence reports these changes together, not that one caused the other.

items.claim: The period settled at 11 hours, 22 minutes and 3 seconds, 33 minutes and 15 seconds shorter than before impact.
items.synthesisExcerpt: The period settled at 11 hours, 22 minutes and 3 seconds, 33 minutes and 15 seconds shorter than before impact.
items.sourceEvidence: Provided source paraphrase: “The period settled at 11 hours, 22 minutes and 3 seconds, 33 minutes and 15 seconds shorter than before impact.”
items.usefulness: Gives the later result and total reduction against baseline.

items.claim: After impact, Dimorphos’s orbit was no longer circular.
items.synthesisExcerpt: The orbit was no longer circular after impact.
items.sourceEvidence: Provided source paraphrase: “The orbit was no longer circular after impact.”
items.usefulness: Adds an orbit-shape change beyond the period change.
items.qualification: The synthesis does not quantify the change in shape.
